svcAssistantDeleteModelBody: Frees up {size} of storage. You'll need to download it again to use the assistant.
svcAssistantIntro: Answers are created on this device from your entries and reports — nothing is uploaded and the conversation isn't saved.
svcAssistantDisclaimer: Not medical advice — answers may contain mistakes.
svcAssistantSetupBody: Ask about appointments, medications, symptoms and reports. The AI model {model} runs entirely on this device — your records are never uploaded. Only the model itself is downloaded once ({size}, ideally over Wi-Fi).
svcAssistantLowMemory: Note: This device has little memory. The assistant may be slow or get closed by Android.
svcAssistantDownloading: Downloading… {percent}% — keeps going even if you leave the app.
svcSemanticActive: Active: answers use the best matches by keyword and by meaning.
svcSemanticIntro:
Also finds entries that don't contain the words of your question (e.g. “thyroid” → TSH level). Downloads {model} ({size}); search then works offline.

Google only provides the model once you accept the Gemma license: create a free Hugging Face account, accept the license on the model page, create a read token and paste it here. The token is only used for the download and is not stored.
svcSemanticDownloadFailed: Download failed — check your token and license. ({error})
svcAssistantAndroidOnly: The assistant only runs on Android.
svcAssistantNeedsAndroid11: The on-device assistant requires Android 11 or later.
svcAssistantNeedsArm64: The on-device assistant requires a 64-bit ARM processor.
svcContextSystemPrompt:
You are the assistant of the app “Mai Doctor Hub”. You answer questions about
the user's personal health record in English, briefly and clearly.
Rules:
- Use only the information in the RECORD section. If something is not in it,
  say honestly that it is not noted in the record.
- Copy dates, times, dosages and values exactly.
- Do not make diagnoses and do not give therapy or dosage recommendations;
  for medical questions, refer the user to a doctor or pharmacist.
- If there are warning signs of an emergency: advise calling the local
  emergency number (112 in Europe, 911 in the US) immediately.
svcSummaryPdfFooter: Created on {date} with Mai Doctor Hub · Patient-reported, not medical documentation
svcSummaryIntro: Questions, symptom history, medications and vaccinations at a glance — as a PDF for your doctor's office.
svcSummaryQuestionsHint: One question per line — notes for the appointment are added automatically
svcReminderCheckInDefault: Take a moment to log your symptoms.

svcBackupTooNew: This backup is from a newer app version — please update the app.
